findings.title: L400 retains a smaller heel land than the maker recommendation
findings.impact: Nominal contact is covered. This is a bounded land/assembly deviation; no required electrical function failure is demonstrated.
findings.fix: Adopt the maker land through a separately covered generator/layout change (2.0x1.8mm pads at local +/-2.25mm), rerunning routing/paste/orientation/DRC/binding; or retain this exact measured deviation with explicit owner/assembler disposition and first-article fillet/tolerance qualification.

retained_output.inference: All board capacitors share one 8.5V node: C84 twice nominal, others +20% tolerance and +15% temperature. No operating-load or divider-discharge credit; no U11 reverse-blocking credit. Capacitor sharing and the doubled C84 envelope are inference, requiring bench verification.

independent_MNA_control.description: Independent block-MNA trapezoidal integration; constant C frozen at +2V, 100pF U9 input,1ns source edge,disabled TVS,0.5us duration. Numerical control only; not validation of nonlinear physical parasitics.

switch_bounce_typical_CV_control.basis: Typical maker C(V); +/-2% resistor envelope,100nA EN sink,0.9 capacitance tolerance,0.85 temperature and0.9 engineering aging factors; integrate R*C(V)/(V+Ileak*R). Not a physical or all-aging guarantee.

additional_power_considerations.VCAP_nominal_topology: C19 and C20 each2.2uF/16V CL10A225KO8NNNC independently join U1 VCAP1/VCAP2 toGND; no additional loads. ST DS12110Table114 typical2.2uF +/-20% does not substitute for actual biased/aged stability qualification.

coverage_limits: No native kicad-cli invocation,DRC,fullcheck.sh,canonical build,GUI,firmware execution,physical/first-article/e-match/flight test,order or acceptance was performed.
This lens revalidated all stored2304 required/60 local records but reran only6 selected extremes,6 no-clamp controls,6 zero-R controls,and2 short frozen-capacitance numerical controls.

Ideal pad/ground coupling,trace/via parasitics and typical capacitor C(V)/temperature factors are not measured manufacturer worst-case bounds;~0.193V negative-input margin and R166579W/2.979mJ durability remain unqualified.
Unfused pack path is owner-selected; installed harness R>=0.03Ohm/L0.1..2uH,pack reserve,star transfer,reference returns,endpoint loop resistance and module/card peaks must be measured.
U9/U400 short-neck/via current sharing,whole-board thermal/DC behavior,U40180..110C/W,R134 hot/repeated pulse behavior and load-FET SOA/turn-on are conditional,not physical qualification.
Camera dropout/loop budget,USB startup/host compatibility,PA6 shedding latency,SD busy current/power loss,actual gate tail,watchdog/reset timing and flight-state retention remain unqualified.

The Littelfuse primary SMBJ asset URL redirected to page-not-found during this review. No new D8 waveform/temperature guarantee is inferred; fresh no-clamp controls pass their assigned reverse-plug corners.

Initial scratch comparison used Python tuples against JSON lists and initially unpacked the3-value thermal API incorrectly; normalization/arity were corrected and all final controls completed. Native API wx/image-handler diagnostics were emitted; final probes exited0.

U9 OVLO at12.6V is nominally1.547368V from2MOhm/280kOhm, above the1.5V recommended range while below its absolute limit; wrong-pack fault-state behavior and loaded dropout remain unqualified. No demonstrated failure is inferred from a recommended-range excursion alone.

Nominal MCU VCAP capacitor topology was checked through the netlist; this lens does not establish all-temperature biased/aged VCAP effective capacitance or core-regulator stability. Generic capacitor derating alone is not treated as a demonstrated MCU failure.
